WITH DPT_ALL AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN LVL < LEAD(LVL) OVER (ORDER BY DEPT_CD) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END IS_FLDR --, CASE WHEN LVL < LEAD(LVL) OVER (ORDER BY DISP_SEQ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END IS_FLDR, , B.CNT AS USR_CNT , A.* FROM ( SELECT LEVEL AS LVL , ROWNUM AS RN , COMPKY -- PK-회사키 , DEPT_CD -- PK-부서코드 , UP_DEPT_CD , DEPT_KR_NM AS DEPT_NM , DISP_SEQ , LPAD(' ', 3 * (LEVEL-1)) || DEPT_KR_NM AS DEPT_KR_NM -- , LPAD(' ', 2*(LEVEL-1)) || DEPT_KR_NM AS DEPT_KR_NMS FROM TB_MAS018 MAS018 --부서정보 WHERE 1=1 AND COMPKY = 'KN' AND USE_YN = 'Y' START WITH UP_DEPT_CD = '00000' CONNECT BY PRIOR DEPT_CD = UP_DEPT_CD ORDER SIBLINGS BY DEPT_CD ) A LEFT JOIN (SELECT DEPART, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM USRMA GROUP BY DEPART ) B ON B.DEPART = A.DEPT_CD )
SELECT * FROM DPT_ALL ORDER BY RN
, SRCHD_DPT AS ( SELECT * FROM TB_MAS018 MAS018 --부서정보 WHERE 1=1 AND COMPKY = 'KN' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND DEPT_KR_NM LIKE '%' || #{DEPT_KR_NM} || '%' ) --SELECT * FROM SRCHD_DPT; , SFNL_TB AS ( SELECT SUB.DEPT_CD SUB_DEPT_CD , MAIN.* FROM DPT_ALL MAIN LEFT JOIN SRCHD_DPT SUB ON SUB.COMPKY = MAIN.COMPKY AND SUB.DEPT_CD = MAIN.DEPT_CD ) --SELECT * FROM SFNL_TB; SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN IS_FLDR = 'N' AND SUB_DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SFNL_TB WHERE IS_FLDR = 'N' AND SUB_DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL START WITH UP_DEPT_CD = A.DEPT_CD CONNECT BY PRIOR DEPT_CD = UP_DEPT_CD ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END DSP_YN , A.* FROM SFNL_TB A -- WHERE 0 < (SELECT COUNT(SUB_DEPT_CD) FROM SFNL_TB) ) WHERE DSP_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY RN
